purpose_ko: RA·RAC·AEC 신규 독립 계약과 정책 평가 엔진의 남은 정책 결정을 위한 임시 검정 기준. 정식 정책, 계약, 스키마, 실행 승인 또는 유효성 판정을 생성하지 않음.

target: RAC and AEC distinct evaluation contracts

pending_tasks: 각 미결정 주제별 사용자 정책 결정
승인 후에만 정식 정책 반영 및 별도 계획 수립

outcome_meanings.PASS: 원본에 고정된 충분한 근거가 해당 임시 기준을 만족
outcome_meanings.FAIL: 확인된 근거가 해당 임시 기준을 위반
outcome_meanings.UNRESOLVED: 승인된 의미 또는 관측 근거 부족으로 결론 보류

pass_if: RA-owned binding meaning is explicit
policy/authority evaluation is not silently transferred to RA
no former Responsibility-Authority schema inheritance
fail_if: RA identity or meaning is inferred from field name or old profile
an unapproved owner or authority is fabricated

evidence: proposed positive and negative RA fixtures
pass_if: approved field semantics and requiredness have machine-verifiable checks
valid and invalid cases are distinguishable by the approved schema and resolver
duplicate keys and unresolved references are rejected by responsible verifier
fail_if: blanket-rejection removal is claimed as schema approval
root schema accepts every input yet a contract-valid PASS is claimed

pass_if: the old schema has no active required references
target file can be deleted without dangling active references
new RA schema does not reuse the old schema as a dependency
fail_if: compatibility shim or cloned legacy schema becomes a required new RA dependency
old schema is deleted while an active consumer requires it

evidence: owner-designated condition identity and responsibility declaration
approved exact Rego source revision and entrypoint
pass_if: RAC condition ID and designated owner resolve exactly
assigned responsibility maps to a registered declaration
Rego source and entrypoint resolve to the exact approved revision
fail_if: RAC owner is assumed from a policy-family name
RAC activation or assignment authority is inferred from schema validation

checks.topic_ko: AEC 조건 소유자와 권한 행사 경계
evidence: registered authority owner and policy basis
linked RAC identity and exact revision
pass_if: AEC condition owner and authority source resolve exactly
the RAC dependency is revision-pinned and evaluated independently
AEC computation does not itself grant operation authorization
fail_if: AEC owner inferred from GOV filename or relationship label
an AEC evaluation result bypasses a current authority/freshness gate

evidence: source-owned exact identity and revision declarations
pass_if: registered identity resolves to an independent source owner and exact revision
missing, duplicate, or conflicting source/owner bindings do not resolve to a valid decision
a derived index does not create policy authority
fail_if: draft index is treated as an activated canonical registry
file path similarity is used to infer ownership

evidence: actual Rego source and runtime version
pass_if: the same registered source/revision gives reproducible evaluation
condition-unsatisfied and missing-evidence scenarios remain distinguishable
actual Rego runtime behavior is verified, not inferred from Python-only simulation
fail_if: tests are asserted to confer policy approval
missing evidence silently becomes successful authorization

checks.topic_ko: 독립 정책 평가 엔진의 신규 책임
evidence: policy evaluation scope and cross-engine boundary proposal
pass_if: the seven existing engines keep their independent ownership
the new evaluator owns Rego evaluation computation without owning normative policy approval
official engine additions and capability registration have separately resolved policy authority
fail_if: Rego core ownership is silently forced onto a prior engine
the new engine is registered or activated solely by this temporary checklist

evidence: authoritative policy approval and current registration evidence
pass_if: definition, structural validity, registration, evaluation and authorization remain distinct
unresolved/unregistered contracts are not advertised as active
execution eligibility is decided only by the responsible currently effective authority
fail_if: schema or temporary criterion PASS is treated as permission to exercise authority
UNREGISTERED contract is activated without authorized transition
